headlines.title: What the founders of Cal AI are doing now after they have sold their app for millions?
headlines.summary: Meet Blake and Zach founders of Cal AI (on track to do ~$50M this year), just cashed out and are already back at it.Blakes new project is called 10X App Builder. The pitch: Shopify, but for apps.Helps with the ideation processHosts user backendsEven helps you design an aesthetic Instagram page for your launchBasically an all-in-one platform so anyone can ship an app without stitching together 10 tools.

headlines.title: Shopify Sinks 7%, Etsy Drops 6%: Is This an E-Commerce Selloff or Just Two Names?
headlines.summary: Shopify and Etsy are getting crushed while the broader e-commerce basket and Latin America's biggest marketplace barely flinch. That gap between the platform names and the sector fund is the only clue worth following right now.

headlines.title: 3 Reasons We Love Shopify (SHOP)
headlines.summary: Shopify trades at $145.34 and has moved in lockstep with the market. Its shares have returned 8.9% over the last six months while the S&P 500 has gained 13.6%.

headlines.title: Alibaba vs. Shopify: Which Retail Platform Is a Better Buy in 2026?
headlines.summary: Alibaba trades at a fraction of Shopify's valuation, but one company is burning cash while the other is generating it.

headlines.title: Airbnb vs. Shopify: Which Consumer Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
headlines.summary: Airbnb generates stronger cash flow and trades at a lower valuation, while Shopify's revenue growth outpaces it by three times, a classic tension between profitability and expansion.

description: Shopify Inc., a commerce technology company, provides tools to start, scale, market, and run a business of various sizes in Canada, the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia Pacific, and Latin America. The Company offers Shopify platform that enables merchants to manage products and inventory, process orders and payments, fulfill and ship orders, build customer relationships, source products, leverage analytics, and reporting and access financing for running their business across all of their sales channels, including web and mobile storefronts, physical retail locations, social media storefronts, and marketplaces. It also provides Shopify Payments, a fully integrated payment processing service that allows merchants to accept and process payment cards online and offline. In addition, the company engages in the sale of themes and apps; shipping labels through Shopify Shipping; point-of-sale hardware; advertising on the Shopify App Store; and Shop Campaigns for buyer acquisitions, as well as registration of domain names. The company was formerly known as Jaded Pixel Technologies Inc. and changed its name to Shopify Inc. in November 2011. Shopify Inc. was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Ottawa, Canada.
